usedFor: Slide runs calls, and Freshsales Classic changes the deal through “Update Deal” after “When a voice call is completed”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a voice call is completed” in Slide, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A finished call is a reason to move the deal's stage or probability.

watchOut: Give “Update Deal” a deal ID or name, or the completed call has nothing to update.
